rationale.com.siddumoni.fakecall.debug.DYNAMIC_REC: AndroidX Core AAR manifest compatibility declaration for RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED runtime receivers on Android before API 33. It is signature-protected. The debug application ID includes the .debug suffix; minSdk 34 means the legacy runtime fallback is unreachable, but the dependency manifest entry remains merged.
rationale.com.siddumoni.fakecall.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_: AndroidX Core AAR manifest compatibility declaration for RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED runtime receivers on Android before API 33. It is signature-protected. minSdk 34 means the legacy runtime fallback is unreachable, but the dependency manifest entry remains merged.
rationale.android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS: Allows the user-approved scheduled simulated-call notification on Android 13+. Runtime permission is requested in context; if denied or later revoked, the app does not launch an Activity or silently downgrade the schedule.
rationale.android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM: Allows a user-selected exact simulated-call schedule only after checking canScheduleExactAlarms() and sending the user to Alarms & reminders special app access when needed. Approximate mode uses an inexact alarm and never requests this access.
rationale.android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE: Restores pending future simulated-call alarms after a device restart through a non-exported receiver. Expired and interrupted records are closed.
